register.labelZh: SELL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sell something off 表示出售不再需要的財產或物品;sell something on 則表示把東西轉售給下一位買家。；sell out 可以表示活動門票售罄;sell out of something 則表示賣方已沒有某種貨品。；sell up 可以表示某人在退休或搬遷前,賣掉住所、生意或大部分財物。；sell somebody out 並不是把某人出售,而是出賣或背叛該人或團體。
register.summaryEn: Sell something off describes getting rid of unwanted property or objects. Sell something on describes selling something to its next owner. Sell out can describe an event with no tickets left. Sell out of something shows that a seller has none of a particular product left. Sell up can describe selling a home, business or most possessions before retiring or moving elsewhere. Sell somebody out does not mean selling a person. It means betraying that person or group.
